stalker__root.title: Magic Arrow
stalker__root.description: Unlocks Magic Arrow (Level 3) (36 mana, 11.4 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
stalker__root.extra_description: Hold to charge a piercing arrow made of arcane energy. This arrow has no gravity and can travel through blocks. The first skill of the Stalker base.

stalker__arrow_tenacity.title: Arrow tenacity
stalker__arrow_tenacity.description: Teaches Arrow tenacity, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Prevent the stun from arrows damage. This skill is permanent, thus you can use another passive on top of it but, you'll only keep the current passive if you die. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen
